title: Convergence of iterates and improved rates for accelerated augmented Lagrangian methods for linearly constrained convex optimization
summary: Motivated by an inertial primal-dual dynamical system with vanishing damping, we propose a class of accelerated augmented Lagrangian methods with Nesterov extrapolation parameters for a linearly constrained convex optimization problem with a differentiable objective function. The framework contains two variants: an implicit-gradient scheme for convex continuously differentiable objectives and a partially explicit scheme for convex smooth objectives.
